{{Quote|The Y-85 Titan dropship deploys AT-AT walkers from Imperial naval warships down to planetary surfaces.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Y-85 Titan dropship''', colloquially known as the '''walker dropship''', was an important [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] used to deploy [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], [[IM-455 modular garrison|prefabricated garrison bases]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] onto [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surfaces.<ref name="ITW:OT" />

==Characteristics==
The Y-85 could accommodate four AT-ATs in addition to four AT-STs. [[Walker/Legends|Walkers]] were held by cranes, clamped along the sides, in battle-ready configuration, and could be quickly deployed via drop-down floor hatches. The Y-85 was armed with two forward twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] for defense.<ref name="ITW:OT" />

Because of the Y-85's size, it could only fit inside larger Imperial ships. The launch bays of smaller vessels, like [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], could only hold landers like the [[Theta-class barge/Legends|''Theta''-class AT-AT barge]] due to their smaller hangar apertures.<ref name="ITW:OT" />

==History==
The Y-85 was only reluctantly used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces because it was manufactured by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], a company that also built the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="ITW:OT" />

The [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] relied on these dropships to deploy its garrison bases when necessary. The Y-85 was credited with delivering walkers to the [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] surface before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|assault]] on [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="ITW:OT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Early [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources claimed that an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] carried 12 "landing barges" of unspecified class. It was stated that these barges were each capable of holding 4 AT-ATs or 8 AT-STs, as well as 1,000 troops.<ref name="SWSB2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

The author [[Curtis Saxton]] found it doubtful that such a large craft could fit inside the hangar of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. He later served as a consultant during the writing of the book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''. This book was not only the first official source to fully depict and name the Y-85, but also confirmed that ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers only have hangars large enough for single-walker landing barges.

An earlier nonfiction book, ''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]], had also portrayed a single-walker barge inside the hangars.
